name: Untrusted Deserialization
essence: A profile request promotes the shared account to administrator.

examples.summary: A profile request promotes the shared account to administrator.
examples.mechanism: JSON received at the profile boundary is deserialized and copied wholesale onto the account, including its privileged admin field.
examples.expected_behavior: admin false; profile updates cannot set authorization fields.

ingredients.suggests: A serialized request body crosses into the account profile receiver.
All parsed fields, including admin, are assigned to the account.

examples.summary: The profile boundary trusts a deserialized admin field and copies it onto the live account..
